subject: PrivDeploy packaging: ops split, capex vs opex scenarios
messages:
From: Aaron Sullivan <aaron.sullivan@brightlabs.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlabs.io
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLabs private deployment — packaging questions and cost model

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to put a few clarifying questions in writing so they can align finance and engineering. High level: BrightLabs wants a private deployment (VPC) for inference of our customer-facing features. We need to understand three things to make a go/no-go decision this month:

1) Platform fee amortization vs one-time operator license (they prefer capex-friendly approach if possible).
2) How the support retainer translates into response SLAs and headcount (we need a mapping: Bronze/Silver/Gold => oncall hours / escalation windows).
3) Any onboarding/implementation credit or accelerator discount for a 24-month committed contract.

I've attached the draft SOW they gave us with scope and expected peak QPS. Can you share a concise set of packaging options and a rough TCO (3-year) comparing a platform-fee amortized model to operator-license (capex) model? Also call out migration credits if we align on a pilot in Q3.

Appreciate it — procurement is aiming to finalize terms by 5/10.

Best,
Aaron
Director, Cloud Ops
BrightLabs

Attachments: BrightLabs_SOW_v1.pdf (85KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Sullivan <aaron.sullivan@brightlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLabs private deployment — packaging questions and cost model

Aaron — thanks for the clear note and the SOW. We can absolutely get you a side-by-side. High level answers first:

• Platform fee amortized (monthly) = predictable OPEX, includes control plane, observability, and continuous runtime improvements. Good if finance wants OpEx.
• Operator license (one-time) = more capex-like; lower recurring platform fee but higher initial invoice and responsibility for some upgrades / optional paid upgrades.
• Support tiers: Bronze = business hours SLAs + 24h follow-ups; Silver = 24/7 asymmetrical oncall + 4h P1; Gold = 24/7 with dedicated SRE hours + 1h P1.

I'll pull a 3-year TCO and a recommended commercial packaging with a pilot credit for a 6-week Q3 pilot. Looping Marissa and Karthik for pricing comps and legal hooks. Expect a proposal by EOD.

—Vanessa
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLabs private deployment — packaging questions and cost model

Vanessa / Karthik — quick notes from pricing:

1) For a 24-month commitment we can offer: 12% discount on platform fee when amortized monthly, or 18% discount on operator-license list when taken as a single invoice (to make capex option attractive).
2) Pilot accelerator: waive first-month platform fee + 50% off implementation retainer if they sign MSA within 45 days of pilot completion. That maps to approx $45k in near-term concession for a mid-sized deployment (numbers in spreadsheet).
3) Support tiers: map as follows for clarity in the SOW: Bronze = 4h P1 escalation (business hours), Silver = 2h P1 (24/7), Gold = 1h P1 + 40 SRE hours/month. We can also create a self-serve telemetry SLA add-on.

Also recommending a Hybrid billing impact line: if they capitalize operator license, recommend a recurring minimal platform maintenance fee (10% annual) to cover control-plane updates and security backports. That reduces our risk and keeps them on a supported track.

I'll attach the pricing matrix; Vanessa can decide which two commercial bundles to present.

—Marissa
Head of Commercial Deals
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLabs private deployment — packaging questions and cost model

Adding technical/ops notes to ensure pricing assumptions are feasible:

• The SOW capacity (peak QPS + 500 concurrent KV sessions) maps to a 4-GPU cluster in their VPC (NVIDIA H100 class). We should price for a base node + burst pool. If they want operator-license, engineering will need an onboarding week for KMS/HSM and airgap checks — factor ~80 engineering hours.
• Migration credits: we can cover up to 50% of the migration SRE hours for the pilot if they commit to 24 months. That aligns with Marissa's pilot accelerator.
• Observability retention: default 30d included; add-on 90/365d for longer retention (priced separately).

If you want, I can prepare a short ops appendix (runtime footprint, expected token throughput, KV cache sizing) to put into the SOW before sending externally.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Sullivan <aaron.sullivan@brightlabs.io>, procurement@brightlabs.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: BrightLabs private deployment — packaging questions and cost model

Aaron — attaching the short proposal and pricing matrix for the two recommended paths (Amortized Platform Fee vs Operator License CAPEX). Key points up front:

1) Amortized Platform Fee (OPEX-first) — 24-month commitment
   • Monthly platform fee (includes control plane, telemetry, automatic kernel improvements) – discounted 12% for 24 months
   • Implementation retainer: $90k (50% waived for pilot if MSA signed within 45 days)
   • Support: Silver by default (24/7, 2h P1); option to upgrade to Gold with 40 SRE hours/mo.
   • Estimated 3-year TCO: $1.45M (spread across OPEX).

2) Operator License (CAPEX-first) — single invoice + recurring maintenance
   • Operator license list: one-time $720k (18% discount for 24-month commit)
   • Annual maintenance (10% of license) to cover control plane/security updates: $72k/year
   • Onboarding engineering: ~80 hours (charged at standard SOW rates if not covered by pilot credit)
   • Estimated 3-year TCO: $1.38M (higher upfront, lower monthly).

3) Pilot accelerator offer: 6-week pilot in Q3 with waived first-month platform fee and up to 50% migration SRE credit, subject to 24-month signature.

4) Next steps / ask from BrightLabs: confirm preferred billing treatment (OPEX vs CAPEX) and whether procurement needs us to provide amortization-friendly invoices (we can issue monthly invoices tied to a PO or provide a single invoice with an amortization schedule for their finance team). We will also include the ops appendix in the SOW.

I've also included the pricing matrix and a redlined SOW stub in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3ExampleLink

If this looks good I can have legal draft the MSA addendum and finance prepare the PO-ready amortization schedule by Thursday (5/06).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: privdeploy-pricing-matrix.xlsx
